---

## Summary

Describe the incorrect behavior.

## Reproduction

Include:

- project version or commit;
- operating system;
- Python and `uv` versions;
- exact commands;
- expected and actual behavior; and
- sanitized logs or screenshots.

Use fictional content only. Do not include credentials, personal data,
confidential conversations, or vulnerability details.

## Boundary impact

Does this affect human review, manual-only delivery, responsible-use
redirection, privacy, retention, purge, or audit behavior?
